en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a frontal view of an elaborately carved wooden double door or cabinet front. Each leaf is divided into three vertical panels with high‑relief figures in niches, likely Christian saints or apostles, framed by scroll and foliage motifs. The surrounding frame is richly decorated with Renaissance‑style vine and acanthus carving. The object stands on a tiled floor against a plain interior wall. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
